text: NORDAGRI N.V. owns 100% of broker-dealer BDD M&V Investments a.d. Beograd, and M&V Investments in turn owns 100% of AIK Banka (AikBank) a.d. Beograd; the whole chain sits inside the AEC Group around Agri Europe Cyprus, the financial holding of Aleksandar Kostic, son of the late Miodrag Kostic.
short: AikBank sits under BDD M&V Investments -> NORDAGRI N.V. -> Agri Europe Cyprus (AEC Group, Kostic family).

source.name: Forbes Crna Gora: Šta Kostićev Agri Europe Cyprus dobija preuzimanjem Hipotekarne banke
source.quote: NORDAGRI N.V. 100% vlasnik Brokersko dilerskog društva "M&V Investments" a.d. Beograd, dok je ova brokerska kuća 100% vlasnik Agroindustrijsko komercijalne banke – AIK banka a.d. Beograd
source.note: Article republishing analysis by portal Bankar about AEC Group's structure. It also describes Agri Europe Cyprus as part of the MK group of Aleksandar Kostić ("Kompanija Agri Europe Cyprus, koja posluje u sastavu MK grupe, Aleksandra Kostića, sina preminulog Miodraga Kostića").
